extraction_notes: Revenue Deficit and Primary Deficit are reported as surpluses for 2017-18, hence reported as 0 for deficit. Capital Outlay as a percentage of GSDP was not directly available and was omitted to avoid computation. 'raised_this_year' refers to the number of cases of excess expenditure in 2017-18 (Appendix 2.6). 'outstanding_over_5_years' refers to the number of grants/appropriations with excess expenditure from 2012-13 and prior years that were not regularized (Appendix 2.7). 'money_value_of_observations_crore' refers to the excess expenditure in 2017-18 (Appendix 2.6). 'pac_recommendations_pending' was not explicitly found.
